recipes.name: Hawaiian Beach Shrimp
ingredients_raw: 2 pounds extra large shrimp (16-20), peeled and deveined, tail left on

steps.text: Mix mayonnaise, sugar, lemon-pepper seasoning, garlic, parsley, and oyster sauce together in a large bowl or resealable bag until well combined. Add shrimp, coat with marinade, squeeze out excess air, and seal the bag. Marinate in the refrigerator, 1 hour to overnight.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate. Soak skewers in water.
Remove shrimp from marinade and shake off excess. Discard remaining marinade. Thread shrimp onto skewers.
Cook shrimp on the preheated grill until pink and firm, 2 to 3 minutes per side.

raw_recipe.headline: Hawaiian Beach Shrimp
raw_recipe.description: Grill shrimp in Hawaii on a hibachi by the seaside or in your own backyard on a grill with this recipe for skewered, marinated morsels of goodness.

video.description: Feeling like doing some travelling while in your kitchen? Then this Hawaiian inspired beach shrimp is the perfect meal to have when you feel a bit of wanderlust coming on!

review.reviewBody: Good recipe but I made a few modifications to make it a little more Hawiian. Skip the 2 TBS of lemon pepper and instead add 1 TBS of fresh cracked black pepper and the juice from one fresh lemon. then take the 1 cup of mayo down to 1/2 cup and add 1 cup of pinapple juice and 1 TBS of fresh minced ginger. If you want to spice it up, add a tsp of Tabasco. Use all the other ingredients per the original recipe. Either way, these shrimp come out great!

Made this for a Hawaiian themed dinner party last night and the only change was subbing cilantro for parsley ('cause hubby grabbed the wrong thing at the store). Marinated all afternoon; delicious! Every single shrimp (and we had 2 pounds) devoured! Have moved this to my favorites (and yes, will keep the cilantro!!)!!

Absolutely loved these moist and flavorful shrimp! The marinade was a snap to throw together. I marinated overnight, and my hubby grilled them perfectly. Only thing, a tad on the salty side. MY fault, I looked at my lemon pepper bottle, first ingredient listed, SALT! I'll make these again with a no salt added blend next time. This will be perfect for summer entertaining, I will use this recipe many more times. Thank you for sharing, iluvpickles. UPDATE 4.20.12: Made this with Penzey's "Sunny Spain: seasoning, their no-salt lemon pepper blend, and added no salt, perfect!
We have had it with both Chicken & Shrimp ......and its a wonderful dish either way!
We really enjoyed this one. Ran out of lemon pepper so substituted lemon zest a little fresh squeezed lemon and black pepper. Hubby loved it. Will make these again
I really loved this recipe!!! Every one ate them up fast!! I skewered them and wrapped them in tinfoil and put on the grill!! Will do it again!!! They were amazing!!

This is some of the best marinade I have ever tasted for shrimp. Instead of grilling, I baked in the marinade for about 15 min. at 350. We put the shrimp in a taco with avocado ranch dressing. Thanks for the recipe!
Easy to make and delicious! I have made this on several occasions with sides of pineapple rice (Zatarain's Caribbean rice mix) and grilled veggies. So good!

This is the best, new shrimp recipe I have tried. I love shrimp (to me? A delicacy) so I love a lot of shrimp recipes but this one! The flavors are so unique, complimentary and wonderful! The only change was me using dried parsley for fresh. The rest? As is! Marinated almost two hours before grilling and I couldn’t get enough! I’m already planning my repeat performance! Thank you for this amazing and delicious recipe!!
Delicious. Used the leftover marinade to baste while on the grill. Served w roasted asparagus and rice w toasted sesame oil, soy sauce and green onions. Adding to our regular rotation.
Made this for company and everyone loved it. I followed the changes tacotpres suggested, cut the mayo to 1/2 cup added 1 cup pineapple juice and ground ginger it was the best shrimp ever

I made this exactly as it was written and it was very good. I marinated overnight. I will definitely make it again, but I might try what others suggested with the pineapple. It was good just as written, but I will try a little change next time.

This marinade was so easy to prepare! I used Black Tiger Shrimp, marinated for 4 hrs, and grilled on a grill pan. It was the most delish shrimp we have ever had - it was the sweet goodness tasting like lobster! Good idea to give it a try! I am thinking of trying it on chicken breast…

I loved this dish and love using my grill whenever I get the chance. This wonderful recipe was a nice change from beef and chicken. I will certainly be making it again. I made mine exactly as the recipe reads, no changes. Sounds like a lot of mayonnaise but you actually need it to keep the shrimp from drying out. I served mine with a tropical fruit salad. Yummm.
Only change I made, was Putting a chunk of pineapple between each shrimp on the skewers. They went SO fast.
